Biometric locks (thumb, iris, blood, whatever you choose). Simple (Moto 1): DV15 Electronics/Security Tech to bypass; a wrong key or failed bypass seals the locks for 20 Rounds and sounds an alarm or pings you. Complex (Moto 5): DV17, plus 4d6 electrical damage to the culprit (through SP, no ablation). Advanced (Moto 7): DV21, plus everyone within 10m is hit as by a Shrieker.

Cost / Moto: Moto Varies
Fits: All Vehicles
